contractual_schedule.note: Single IA document on disk, no amendments found. POI = Brashear Switch, Hopkins County, on TSP's Sandy Ranch Switch-Cash Switch 345kV line (Exhibit C). 29x Power Electronics FS4010 solar inverters, 4.01 MVA each, gross 116.29 MVA, dispatched 101.8 MW at generator terminals/100.8 MW at 34.5kV bus. Generator must submit panel lat/lon+KMZ by 2026-11-05 (not yet due) -- panel layout unfinalized at signing. Per-contract grading/access-road work at Brashear Switch not complete until 2026-08-14, i.e. IA schedule itself does not expect visible site construction before mid-2026.
